The original tests/test_hand_regression.py is retained as .py.txt, for provenance
only. It is never imported or executed. anchor.json adapts the literal synthetic
sequence in test_hand_respects_existing_fingering_anchor: twelve ascending
chromatic pitches beginning at MIDI 60, with finger 5 fixed on the second note.
The original test stubs its optimizer; we test the retained anchor against our
real TypeScript search instead. No expected full sequence is invented.

Source one-second notes are represented as quarter notes (.25 whole-note units)
in our legacy API. No source score, PIG annotation, optimizer code or external
installation script was imported or executed. This is an anchor-retention test,
not an expert ergonomic evaluation of that chromatic fingering.
